Flex is the diversified manufacturing partner of choice that helps market-leading brands design, build and deliver innovative products that improve the world. To support our extraordinary teams who build great products and contribute to our growth, we’re looking to add a Manager - Finance & Strategy in Chennai, India.

Manager - Finance & Strategy within India Corporate Strategy (CS) team, you will work in a growing global team, providing industry and financial expertise and insights, working together with Flex CS leadership and internal stakeholders to deliver customized knowledge assets and expert advisory.

As a member of the team, you will support internal and external stakeholders with deep expertise in competitor and industry benchmarking, M&A target evaluation and due diligence, financial analysis and forecasting, strategic planning, portfolio assessment, and value optimization.

What a typical day looks like:

• The role will involve developing valuation and projection models, conduct market sizing and industry-level financial analysis, and apply corporate finance metrics and trading multiples to assess businesses, competitors, industry segments, niche markets, and emerging or underpenetrated verticals.
• Support strategic assessments related to mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and portfolio optimization.
• Support in providing financial data and analysis leveraging specialized finance, accounting, corporate finance (CF) concepts, deep rooted knowledge in financial analysis, CF understanding relating to valuation/enterprise value/multiples of businesses/industries, and forecasting/projections related tools/frameworks
• Analyze companies from a financial, enterprise value, accounting, operational, and industry perspective, competitive benchmarking, mergers and acquisitions (M&A) due diligence
• Deep rooted knowledge of financial models and be able to create financial models based on business issues or transactions being analyzed and get the team to deliver high-quality valuation work products
• Lead & drive key initiatives/deliverables with CSO office and Business Unit (BU) leaders on strategic initiatives
• Contributes and enhances content development around topic/sector for key internal deliverables (Market Factbook, Competitive Intelligence, News updates), meetings & trainings
• Support India CS leadership on proposals, operational and other marketing activities
• Serve as a thought partner to BU leaders and global stakeholders, helping navigate Corporate Strategy priorities by connecting them with relevant insights, resources, and expertise.
• Collaborate with global and cross-functional teams to support enterprise-wide strategic initiatives and priorities.
• Partner with leadership to identify and incubate new capabilities, improve operating effectiveness, and strengthen team performance to support the next phase of growth.

The experience we’re looking to add to our team: 

• 8+ years of relevant experience required (consulting/strategy with Corporate Finance (3-5 years of valuation hand on experience) specialization preferred)
• Consulting background with functional expertise in Finance having managed end-to-end client projects on topics of strategy & transformation
• Bachelor’s degree required; an advanced degree or professional qualification such as CFA or CA is preferred.
• Ability to build & maintain a strong network
• Ability to provide analytical insights
• Proficiency in MS Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel
• Ability to operate effectively in a fast paced, cross functional, global organization
• Strong interpersonal skills, collaborative, team player
• Fluency in English, location preferably in Chennai (on-site)

About The Job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

The mission of the Google Workspace team is to deliver flexible, innovative solutions for people and organizations to achieve more. As a Product Manager, you will drive product strategy and set product priorities. You will partner closely with Engineering and cross-functional teams to define and deliver on cloud services.

AI will change the future of work in profound ways, and our products— Gmail, Docs, Drive, Calendar, Sheets, Vids and Meet are at the forefront. From pre-computed summaries for email threads, summaries for meetings, and videos created from a document using lifelike AI avatars, our AI opportunity is huge. Our mission is to meaningfully connect people so they can create, build, and grow together and as part of the team you can build how productivity tools should work 5-10 years into the future. You will work with model builders (Google DeepMind), work with exceptional leaders, and have the ability to impact billions of users across the world.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Define the product direction and strategy for product areas within Google Workspace.
• Design and lead the product roadmap by managing goals and investments to scale globally.
• Engage with customers to understand their strategies, end-to-end business processes, pain points, and priorities to inform product strategy and provide transparency into roadmaps/managing expectations.
• Partner closely with Engineering, UX, and other internal Google teams to drive product and delivery success. Analyze landscape and industry trends to advance our products and drive innovation.
• Foster and facilitate timely decision-making across a broad network of stakeholders, delivery partners, and operational teams. Attract, develop, and retain an excellent team of product managers.

About Prove 

As the world moves to a mobile-first economy, businesses need to modernize how they acquire, engage with and enable consumers. Prove’s phone-centric identity tokenization and passive cryptographic authentication solutions reduce friction, enhance security and privacy across all digital channels, and accelerate revenues while reducing operating expenses and fraud losses. For the latest updates from Prove, follow us on LinkedIn.

Prove is driving the future of digital identity. We are looking for Provers who know how to make an impact. We’re talking self-starting professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment, process information quickly, and make intelligent decisions. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together.   

Prove has big plans, and we’re excited about the future. If this sounds like the place for you – come join our team! 

Title: Sales Engineer - Partnerships 

Department: Solutions & Implementation

Reports To: Director, Sales Engineering

FLSA Status: Exempt

Location: US (Remote)

Position Summary

Prove empowers our customers to create memorable customer experiences for every channel of interaction with their clients. As subject matter experts in these experiences, our Solutions Engineers provide the organization with product and market expertise and are a lynchpin to Prove's sustainable growth.

We are client facing and work with our team of Sales Directors and Strategists to properly communicate our solutions and describe their implementation to customer opportunities and sometimes even post-sale implementation teams. We work with our product leaders to understand Prove's capabilities and changing abilities, inwardly communicating market trends and unmet needs so that our products are always at or ahead of the market.

Day-to-day we think in terms of patterns and tools. We want to empower growth by providing the Sales Directors with tools that educate and explain with minimal commentary. We are clear and confident communicators, ensuring that the organization remains aligned and our clients are informed partners.

Key Responsibilities:

• Design and clearly communicate solutions, demonstrating that you have a clear grasp of business value as well as technical challenges

• Partner with Sales Directors, Account Managers, and Strategic Account Managers to drive the technical win and align with technical buyer during the sales cycle.  Participate in IPM / OM hand-off as necessary.

• Partner with Sales Directors to lead product and technology evaluations, ensuring successful client engagements. 

• Deliver effective and detailed product presentations and demonstrations. 

• Build credibility with prospects through expert knowledge of product, technical, business, and industry domains. 

• Address business and technical challenges with tailored Prove services and solutions. 

• Assisted sales teams in articulating value propositions and selecting optimal solutions. 

• Proof of Concept (POC Data Study) - Support Sales Director in execution of approved POC Data Studies in conjunction with Data Science.

• Support as needed the handoff to Onboarding Manager, IMP, Account Manager at the different stages of customer lifecycle - setting those teams up for success

• Work and communicate cross-functionally with Sales Directors, Account Management, Onboarding, Implementation and Solutions Consulting, Product Management and Executive teams to support efforts to close new customers and set them up for a successful implementation.

• Stay informed with key industry trends & market disruptors, through reading, workshops, webinars

• Create public facing architecture/flows of the Partner + Prove integrations (ex for an online Marketplace listing)

• Enable Prove SE’s and IPMs on the technical integrations so they can speak accurately/confidently about these offerings alongside our sellers

• Enable Partner technical counterparts (SEs, SCs, etc.)  on both the Prove value prop as well as our integration so they can support the partner’s sellers in the field

• In partnership with a GTM Partnerships counterpart, own the technical and product evaluation and eventual integration planning and scoping of net new partner integrations

Qualifications and Experience:

• At least 2 years previous success with relevant experience in solutions architecture, technical pre-sales, or solutions engineering

• Experience in a high growth startup, technical environment

• Technical experience with implementing REST style API’s

• Solid understanding of oAuth and other API authentication technologies

• Good level of understanding of API integrations from standard API specifications in one or more programming languages such as Javascript, Java, C++, Python, etc.

• Ability to build customized workflows by engaging with customers

• Understanding of basic security concepts such as encryption, hashing, behavior biometrics, and native app SDK’s

• Must be responsive and dedicated to clients, both internal and external

• Strong verbal and writing skills

• Strong storytelling skills and client interaction skills

• Clear sense of ownership and accountability

• Self-starter, capacity to learn at a fast pace

• Experience in cybersecurity, fintech, or fast-growing startup is preferred

The anticipated salary pay range for Metro 2 areas for this role is $125,000 - 135,000 plus sales incentive plan.

The anticipated salary pay range for Metro 3 areas for this role is $110,000 - 123,000 plus sales incentive plan.

4cb9c752bc769592.description:
Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.

Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.

Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.

As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.

We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.

Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.

About the Role: 

A Senior Infrastructure Solutions Engineer makes Planet's infrastructure easier to use. Infra Solutions is a small, multi-disciplinary team: engineers who are as comfortable operating a system as building one, and as comfortable in a hard conversation as in a code review. We sit between the teams who build Planet's platform capabilities and the teams who need them, and our market is every engineering team at Planet, which we earn one engagement at a time. Teams work with us because we make their week lighter, not because anyone told them to, and every team that lands on the platform is infrastructure Planet no longer has to duplicate, secure and pay for.

Most of what you do takes the shape of a hands-on engagement with a team that is blocked, mid-migration, or arriving on the platform for the first time. They usually arrive with a proposed solution rather than the problem behind it, and working out the difference is where the engagement starts. From there you own it end to end: the diagnosis, the hands-on fix, the argument for what should change upstream, and the durable artifact that stops the next team hitting the same wall. This is a role driven by unreasonable hospitality (value out of proportion to what anyone asked us for) and backed by solid engineering and operator depth. You have run things in production, and you write the code other engineers depend on. The ideal candidate is energized by other teams' success: someone who would rather ship the thing that makes ten teams faster than own a system outright, and who does their best work in a room they don't own, with people who are not yet convinced they need help.

This is a full-time, remote position based in Germany, the Netherlands or Slovenia. If located near a Planet office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week.

Impact You’ll Own:

  • Lead end-to-end technical engagements: Partner directly with engineering teams to diagnose, unblock, and resolve complex infrastructure challenges.
  • Execute critical migrations: Develop reference implementations, tooling, and guidance to transition teams off deprecated systems seamlessly.
  • Accelerate platform adoption: Act as the primary technical contact for new teams onboarding to Planet’s core infrastructure.
  • Establish standardized paths: Consolidate disparate solutions into well-supported, paved-road infrastructure offerings.
  • Build scalable, shared artifacts: Design re-usable libraries, Terraform modules, and Helm charts to solve recurring technical patterns across teams.
  • Enhance platform observability: Implement instrumentation and attribution tooling to provide visibility into infrastructure cost, usage, and adoption.
  • Inform platform strategy: Synthesize engineering feedback and common pain points to influence the broader infrastructure roadmap.

What You Bring:

  • 6+ years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering, including experience leading at least one cross-team project or migration.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Background in technical enablement, developer experience, or solutions architecture with a focus on internal developer productivity.
  • Hands-on experience operating and maintaining production infrastructure environments.
  • Deep expertise with Kubernetes orchestration, including workload optimization and operations.
  • Working knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or other public cloud providers, including its compute, storage, quota, and capacity mode.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Proficiency in software development using Go or Python.
  • Ability to translate ambiguous requirements into structured, actionable engineering tasks.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and cross-functional collaboration.

What Makes You Stand Out:

  • Experience with large-scale block storage (Persistent Disk, Hyperdisk, Ceph, SAN, or equivalent) operated at fleet scale rather than per-service.
  • Experience driving large-scale migrations or deprecations that required buy-in from teams outside your reporting line.
  • Experience in a consulting-adjacent engineering role (solutions architecture, professional services, or technical account engineering) applied to an internal platform.
  • Familiarity with workflow orchestration (e.g. Temporal), batch and job-execution systems, or large-scale data processing pipelines.
  • Experience defining and measuring platform adoption: developer-productivity instrumentation, NPS, or internal marketshare.

Application Deadline:

11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.

The Account Program Manager (APM) serves as the strategic partner and relationship manager for Collibra Public Sector’s Federal customers.
